title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A confident young female warrior with long dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic pose. She wears an orange cropped top with red patterns, dark pants with purple armor plates, and holds a massive purple warhammer with intricate designs in her right hand.
prompt: A young East Asian female warrior with long dark hair tied in a topknot stands in a powerful stance against a plain background. She wears an orange cropped top with red tribal patterns, dark purple pants, purple armored knee pads and boots, and a purple belt with dangling charms. She holds a large ornate purple warhammer with both intricate geometric designs and a long wrapped handle. Her expression is confident with a slight smirk, one hand raised near her face, wearing fingerless gloves. Detailed digital painting with clean cel-shaded style.
